name: Focus timer
summary: Pomodoro sessions with breaks and a gentle nudge when time's up.
description:
Work in focused blocks with breaks in between, and a longer break after every few sessions. The ring shows how much of the session is left, the dots show how close the long break is, and a desktop notification tells you when to switch.

Press Space to start or pause. Skip moves straight to the next phase. Lengths, the long-break rhythm and auto-start are in the widget's settings.

settings.label: Long break after this many sessions
